Welcome to The Soundcheck , a biweekly music column keeping you in the loop on what’s happening across the Tarrant music scene. Few things are more Texas than a good contradiction. The Lone Star State can be fiercely protective of its traditions while making room for a few new, unexpected exceptions. Sometimes, the best way to make sense of it all is to write a song. That’s the thinking behind “Accidentally Legal,” the forthcoming single from Fort Worth band Two Guys Walk Into A Bar . Scheduled for release Dec. 5, the song takes a wry look at Texas’ evolving relationship with cannabis, finding its inspiration somewhere between the dispensary counter…
